subject: MAP restart - introducing new champion and updated evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@ledgerflow.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@ledgerflow.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP conversation - team changes on our side

Neha,

Quick note from our side — we went through a reorg last week and I’m moving the LLM initiative over to Sarah (cc’d). I’ll still be involved, but Sarah will be the day-to-day champion. We stalled the evaluation while we sorted roles but want to get back on track with a focused MAP so we can close in Q1 if everything looks good.

Can you do two things:
- Re-send an updated mutual action plan with clear owners and dates.
- Suggest a condensed evaluation timeline (2–3 weeks preferred) and the minimal artifacts we need to produce for procurement.

Thanks — I’d like to get something on the calendar this week.

Best,
Tom
Tom Gallagher
Head of Partnerships | LedgerFlow
attachments: previous-MAP.pdf (referenced)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@ledgerflow.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@ledgerflow.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP conversation - team changes on our side

Hi Tom and Sarah — welcome Sarah, and thanks for the heads-up.

Rishi (AE) and Vivek (Solutions Engineer) are looped in; I’ll be driving the MAP from Redwood's side. I attached a refreshed MAP (LedgerFlow-MAP-v2.pdf) that narrows the scope to the core billing + reconciliation flows you flagged, and it maps out owners, success criteria, and a condensed 3-week evaluation with milestones. High level:

Week 0 (this week): kickoff + access checklist (who needs SSO, sample data)
Week 1: integration & demo (Vivek leads; basic inference on sample set)
Week 2: scale/load check + latency/cost profiling (batching/quantization suggestions)
Week 3: results review, procurement checklist, and decision window

Proposed kickoff slots: Tue 2026-10-21 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 2026-10-22 14:00–14:45 PT. I attached an .ics with both options (LedgerFlow-eval-schedule.ics).

Please confirm who on your side will provide: a) a representative sample of anonymized transactions (S3/CSV), b) security questionnaire contact for the vendor pack, and c) the legal review timing. We’ve also linked the HubSpot MAP record for visibility.

Next steps we’ll take once you confirm: finalize owners, turn the MAP into a shared Google Doc, and ship a sandbox token for initial integration.

-Neha Kapoor
Sr. Account Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0132
attachments: LedgerFlow-MAP-v2.pdf; LedgerFlow-eval-schedule.ics
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@ledgerflow.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@ledgerflow.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP conversation - team changes on our side

Thanks Neha — Sarah here. Quick answers:
- I’ll own the procurement path on our side and coordinate legal; my manager will be on the review loop but I’ll drive timelines.
- We can provide a 1-month anonymized extract by Friday if Vivek/Solutions needs that, or a smaller sample for the initial demo.

Kickoff: Wed 2026-10-22 at 14:00 PT works best for me. Can Vivek run a 30–45 minute technical walkthrough + short hands-on? Also, note we’re particularly sensitive to any data egress and want KMS/HSM notes up front.

Appreciate the condensed plan — if we can get a clear procurement checklist and SOC2/KMS notes into the shared MAP by the end of week 1, we’ll be in good shape.

-Sarah Lin
Senior Product Manager | LedgerFlow
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@ledgerflow.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@ledgerflow.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP conversation - team changes on our side (confirmed kickoff)

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Sarah. Confirming kickoff Wed 2026-10-22 14:00 PT on the invite we sent (attached .ics). Agenda for the 30–45 minute session:
- Intros & roles (5 min)
- Integration checklist + access steps (10 min)
- Live demo on anonymized sample / expected outputs (15–20 min)
- Next milestones & owners (5–10 min)

Vivek will lead the technical portion and will bring a short runbook for the integration steps. Rishi will own the MAP milestones/decision checkpoints and will update the shared MAP doc post-kickoff.

I’ve added a short procurement checklist and SOC2/KMS notes to the Drive MAP folder; link above. If there are any legal/regulatory constraints beyond what you’ve flagged, please loop them in by EOD Monday so we can incorporate before week 1.

Looking forward — we’ll get the sandbox token to you within 48 hours of kickoff and an updated MAP Google Doc (editable) within 24 hours after the meeting.

-Neha
Sr. Account Manager | Redwood Inference
